_comment: PLACEHOLDER VALUES, untested starting points chosen for a first manual paper test. They are not tuned and not a recommendation. Change freely. Paper results never establish live profitability.

rule_params._comment: Rule A: time window + displayed size + premium band. No directional opinion. Band starts at 1.00 because round-trip friction makes a net 15% target unreachable on cheap premiums.

_quote_max_age_note: 90s suits hand-typed quotes. Drop to a few seconds if a real feed is ever connected.

fees._comment: Verify against your broker's schedule. Regulatory fees on sells are not modeled.

contracts._comment: Edit each morning: same-day expiry, strikes near the SPY price you see.

orb._comment: ORB (opening range breakout) on SPY. First candidate from docs/research-2026-10-02.md. PLACEHOLDERS for you to review; untested, not tuned, not a recommendation.
orb.trigger: first completed 1-minute close above range high (CALL) or below range low (PUT); one trade per day

contract.rights: CALL on break up, PUT on break down
